name: (E-)Skånepanelen: Online Citizen Panel and its Citizen Groups in Skåne, Sweden
content: Problems and Purpose Skånepanelen is a citizen panel and an onlinesurvey whose purpose is to gain greater insight into citizens' knowledge, expectations, andattitudes on public services provided by the region. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities The panel was organized by the region of Skåne. Participant Recruitment and Selection Participants must at least be residents of Skåne and over 18 years old. The panel and online surveyconsisted of 3000 randomly selected participants (the number varies year to year, but is between 3000 and 5000participants). The responserate varies between 73-87 percent. Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation The survey isoftencombined with focus groups and face-to-face meetings withcitizens and, thus, part of a broaderstrategicinitiative called“Open Skåne 2030”,to includecitizens in the policy making process. Influence, Outcomes, and Effects The results of thee-citizens panel is summarized in atleast onereport every year. According to theregion, thecitizen panel facilitates increased knowledge about thepreferences and needs of citizens in the region. The results are disseminated online and the municipality executive committee discusses each report.Another outcomementioned by the region is that participating in the panel and subsequent face-to-face, deliberative dialoguesincreases citizens’ knowledge about the services provided by the region. Analysis and Lessons Learned See Also References External Links Notes This entry is based on the POLITICIZE dataset.
